findings.title: `remember --dry-run` and `admit --file` text-mode views misrender results and violate preview contract
findings.evidence: crates/clio-lib/src/cli_write_core.rs:80-86,263-295; executing `clio remember "test" --category persona --dry-run --output text` outputs `stored ? (admission_score 0.7100000000000001)` falsely indicating mutation; executing `clio admit --file ops.json --output text` outputs a bare `preview` string omitting batch summary counts (`would_admit`, `would_reject`, `writes`)
findings.requirement_ref: phase-100370 §1 Expected Outcome ("`clio remember --dry-run` and `clio admit ...` print score and factors without writing"), §5 Task 1, §8 (T100370-02), AC-100370-02, gaps/full-cli.md §6
findings.recommendation: In `CoreWriteGroup::render` (`crates/clio-lib/src/cli_write_core.rs`), inspect the payload: if `payload.get("dry_run") == Some(&Value::Bool(true))` or `verb == "admit"`, route to `render_preview(payload)` rather than `render_stored(payload)`. In `render_preview`, handle batch preview payloads (when `summary` or `count` is present, render `preview: {count} items (would_admit: {would_admit}, would_reject: {would_reject})`). Add unit tests in `cli_write_core_tests.rs` for both text-mode outputs.

plan_unlimited: Harmonize dry-run preview contract across all write groups: pass execution context/mode to `WriteGroup::render` so groups have uniform, first-class access to whether an invocation is dry-run, avoiding heuristics on payload fields.

Introduce an automated golden snapshot test suite across all CLI verbs (both read and write surfaces) in both `--output json` and `--output text` modes to prevent UX drift and ensure consistent rendering.
